text: Welcome. To begin, point your controller at Gun Assembly, and pull the trigger.
In this training, you will put a pistol together, and then check that it works. When you are ready, point at Start training, and pull the trigger.
Well done.
Good.
First, pick up the glowing barrel. Reach out, and squeeze the grip button on the side of your controller.
Now put the barrel into the slide. Move it to the glowing outline, and it will click into place.
Next, pick up the recoil spring.
Slide the spring in, just under the barrel.
Next, pick up the slide.
Now put the slide onto the frame. You can use both hands to turn it.
Next, pick up the magazine.
Push the magazine up, into the grip.
Not quite. The part went back to the bench. Pick up the glowing part, and try again.
The pistol is assembled.
Now, let's check that it works. Pick up the pistol by its grip.
Pick the pistol back up by its grip, and we will carry on.
First, turn the safety on. Press the A button, on the hand holding the pistol.
First, turn the safety on. Press the X button, on the hand holding the pistol.
The safety is on. Watch the glowing trigger. It moves all the way back, and then forward again.
Now you try. Pull the trigger all the way back.
Good. The hammer did not move.
Now let go of the trigger.
Now turn the safety off. Press A again.
Now turn the safety off. Press X again.
Watch the trigger once more. This time, the hammer will drop.
Click. The hammer dropped.
Keep holding the trigger back.
Now watch the glowing slide. It moves all the way back, then springs forward.
With your other hand, grab the back of the slide. Pull it back, then let go.
Keep the trigger pulled while you pull the slide. Let's try that again.
You let go of the trigger too early. Pull it, hold it, and pull the slide again.
Watch the trigger. It moves forward slowly, and stops at a click.
Now you try. Let the trigger out slowly, and stop when you hear the click.
That click means the trigger has reset.
Watch the trigger one last time.
Now pull the trigger all the way, one last time.
Well done. The pistol works correctly.
Your training is complete. You can train again, or go back to the modules.
